description: Nouvelle-Aquitaine : Trafic du réseau routier de Bordeaux Métropole - Localisation (ponctuel) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carto.sigena.fr. This dataset contains the location of the counting points describing the traffic of the Bordeaux metropolis for the years 2011 to 2015, year N being 2015. This data is collected from Bordeaux Métropole via its Open Data portal. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "New-Aquitaine: Traffic of the Bordeaux Metropole road network — Location (one-off)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include métropole, bordeaux, données ouvertes, trafic. The listing shows 2016-09-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
